'''Geo-Engineering Corps''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Nadrin Tro]] of the [[New Thinking Division]] consulted the Geo-Engineering Corps during the mission to stabilize [[Makeb]] and secure its [[isotope-5]] deposits.
